```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr)
library(dplyr)

# Dados
df <- data.frame(
  Radiation = factor(c("High", "Moderate", "Low"), levels = c("High", "Moderate", "Low")),
  No_rain = c( 98.71, 96.81 , 86.73),
  Rain = c(1.29, 3.17 , 13.19),
  Extreme_rain = c(0, 0.02 , 0.08)
)

# Converter para formato longo
df_long <- df %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = -Radiation, names_to = "Precipitation", values_to = "Probability")

# Criar rótulos de precipitação para o facet
df_long$Precipitation <- factor(df_long$Precipitation,
                                levels = c("No_rain", "Rain", "Extreme_rain"),
                                labels = c("No Rain", "Rain", "Extreme Rain"))

# Gráfico
g_rad = ggplot(df_long, aes(x = Probability/100, y = Radiation, fill = Radiation)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.5, color = "black", alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0(Probability, "%")), 
          hjust = -0.1, size = 3) +
  facet_wrap(~ Precipitation, ncol = 1, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("lightblue2", "skyblue3", "steelblue")) +
  labs(x = "Conditional Probability", y = "Radiation Level") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "beige", color = NA),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "none",
    panel.border = element_rect(color = "grey60", fill = NA),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 9),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 9)
  )

ggsave(
  filename = "C:/Users/Pichau/INMET/probabilidades_condicionais/cond_prob_radiacao_atualizado.png",
  plot = g_rad,
  width = 7,
  height = 5,
  dpi = 300,
  bg = "white"  # 🔥 garante fundo branco no arquivo salvo
)


```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr)
library(dplyr)

# ---- Dados ----
df_rad <- data.frame(
  
  Variable = "Radiation",
  Level = factor(c("High", "Moderate", "Low"), levels = c("High", "Moderate", "Low")),
  
  No_rain = c( 98.71, 96.81 , 86.73),
  Rain = c(1.29, 3.17 , 13.19),
  Extreme_rain = c(0, 0.02 , 0.08)
)

df_wind <- data.frame(
  
# Atualizado 
  Variable = "Wind",
  Level = factor(c("High", "Moderate", "Low"), levels = c("High", "Moderate", "Low")),
  No_rain = c(92.86, 87.76, 92.47),
  Rain = c(7.07, 12.14, 7.49),
  Extreme_rain = c(0.07, 0.10, 0.04)
)


# Atualizado 
df_hum <- data.frame(
  Variable = "Humidity",
  Level = factor(c("High", "Moderate", "Low"), levels = c("High", "Moderate", "Low")),
  No_rain = c(86.61,97.05 , 98.90 ),
  Rain = c(13.32,2.93 ,1.09 ),
  Extreme_rain = c(0.07, 0.02, 0.01 )
  
)

# ---- Combina e alonga ----
df_all_long <- bind_rows(df_rad, df_wind, df_hum) |>
  pivot_longer(c(No_rain, Rain, Extreme_rain),
               names_to = "Precipitation", values_to = "Probability") |>
  mutate(
    Precipitation = factor(Precipitation,
                           levels = c("No_rain","Rain","Extreme_rain"),
                           labels = c("No Rain","Rain","Extreme Rain")),
    prop = Probability/100,
    # posição do rótulo, com "empurrão" à direita e clamp no 1.05
    label_x = pmin(prop + 0.015, 1.05),
    label_txt = paste0(sprintf("%.2f", Probability), "%")
  )

# ---- Gráfico combinado com rótulos ----
g_all <- ggplot(df_all_long, aes(x = prop, y = Level, fill = Level)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.5, color = "black", alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_text(aes(x = label_x, label = label_txt),
            hjust = 0, size = 2.1) +
  facet_grid(Precipitation ~ Variable, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1),
                     limits = c(0, 1.08)) +  # espaço para os rótulos
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("lightblue2","skyblue3","steelblue")) +
  labs(x = "Conditional Probability", y = "Level") +
  theme_light(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    plot.background  = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "beige", color = NA),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 9, color = "black"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 8),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 9),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 9),
    legend.position = "none",
    panel.border = element_rect(color = "grey60", fill = NA)
  )

ggsave(
  filename = "C:/Users/Pichau/INMET/probabilidades_condicionais/cond_prob_radiacao_atualizado.png",
  plot = g_rad,
  width = 20,      # antes 7
  height = 12,      # antes 5
  dpi = 400,       # maior resolução
  bg = "white"
)

```




```{r}

library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr)
library(dplyr)

# Dados
dados <- data.frame(
  Humidity = factor(c("High", "Moderate", "Low"), 
                    levels = c("Low", "Moderate", "High")),
  No_rain = c(0.7349, 0.9688, 0.9949),
  Rain = c(0.2624, 0.0308, 0.0051),
  Extreme_rain = c(0.0027, 0.0004, 0)
)

# Converter para formato longo
dados_long <- dados %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = -Humidity, names_to = "Precipitation", values_to = "Probability") %>%
  mutate(Precipitation = factor(Precipitation, 
                                levels = c("No_rain", "Rain", "Extreme_rain")))

# Paleta inspirada em meteorologia (azul → chuva, azul-claro → sem chuva)
cores <- c(
  "No_rain" = "#A7C7E7",       # azul-claro acinzentado
  "Rain" = "#4A90E2",          # azul médio
  "Extreme_rain" = "#001F54"   # azul escuro profundo
)

# Gráfico final
ggplot(dados_long, aes(x = Humidity, y = Probability, fill = Precipitation)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = position_dodge(width = 0.75), width = 0.6,
           color = "black", linewidth = 0.2) +
  geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.2f%%", Probability * 100)),
            position = position_dodge(width = 0.75),
            vjust = -0.4, size = 3, color = "black", family = "sans") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = cores,
                    labels = c("No rain", "Rain", "Extreme rain")) +
  labs(
    x = "Humidity level (1h lag)",
    y = "Conditional probability",
    fill = "Precipitation",
    title = ""
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1.05), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    text = element_text(family = "sans"),
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 11.5, face = "plain"),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 10),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 9),
    legend.position = "top",
    legend.title = element_text(size = 9),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 9),
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    panel.border = element_rect(color = "grey60", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.3),
    axis.line = element_line(color = "grey40", linewidth = 0.3)
  )

# Salvar com fundo branco
ggsave(
  filename = "C:/Users/Pichau/INMET/probabilidades_condicionais/vento_umidade_lag1h.png",
  width = 6,
  height = 4,
  dpi = 300,
  bg = "white"
)



```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr)
library(dplyr)

# Dados
df_umidade <- data.frame(
  Humidity = factor(c("High", "Moderate", "Low"), levels = c("High", "Moderate", "Low")),
  No_rain = c(86.65, 97.03, 98.89),
  Rain = c(13.32, 2.24, 1.08),
  Extreme_rain = c(0.03, 0.73, 0.03)
)

# Converter para formato longo
df_umidade_long <- df_umidade %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = -Humidity, names_to = "Precipitation", values_to = "Probability")

# Ajustar rótulos
df_umidade_long$Precipitation <- factor(df_umidade_long$Precipitation,
                                        levels = c("No_rain", "Rain", "Extreme_rain"),
                                        labels = c("No Rain", "Rain", "Extreme Rain"))

# Criar gráfico
g_umidade <- ggplot(df_umidade_long, aes(x = Probability/100, y = Humidity, fill = Humidity)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.5, color = "black", alpha = 0.7) +

            hjust = -0.15, size = 4.2, fontface = "bold", color = "black") +  # 🔹 rótulo maior
  facet_wrap(~ Precipitation, ncol = 1, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1),

  scale_fill_manual(values = c("lightblue2", "skyblue3", "steelblue")) +

    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "beige", color = NA),

    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 9),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 9),

    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 10),
    legend.position = "none",
    panel.border = element_rect(color = "grey60", fill = NA)
  )

# Salvar imagem
dir.create("C:/Users/Pichau/INMET/probabilidades_condicionais", showWarnings = FALSE)
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr)
library(dplyr)

df_rad <- data.frame(
  
  Variable = "Radiation",
  Level = factor(c("High", "Moderate", "Low"), levels = c("High", "Moderate", "Low")),
  
  No_rain = c( 98.71, 96.81 , 86.73),
  Rain = c(1.29, 3.17 , 13.19),
  Extreme_rain = c(0, 0.02 , 0.08)
)

df_wind <- data.frame(
  
# Atualizado 
  Variable = "Wind",
  Level = factor(c("High", "Moderate", "Low"), levels = c("High", "Moderate", "Low")),
  No_rain = c(92.86, 87.76, 92.47),
  Rain = c(7.07, 12.14, 7.49),
  Extreme_rain = c(0.07, 0.10, 0.04)
)


# Atualizado 
df_hum <- data.frame(
  Variable = "Humidity",
  Level = factor(c("High", "Moderate", "Low"), levels = c("High", "Moderate", "Low")),
  No_rain = c(86.61,97.05 , 98.90 ),
  Rain = c(13.32,2.93 ,1.09 ),
  Extreme_rain = c(0.07, 0.02, 0.01 )
  
)


# ---- Combina e alonga ----
df_all_long <- bind_rows(df_rad, df_wind, df_hum) |>
  pivot_longer(c(No_rain, Rain, Extreme_rain),
               names_to = "Precipitation", values_to = "Probability") |>
  mutate(
    Precipitation = factor(Precipitation,
                           levels = c("No_rain","Rain","Extreme_rain"),
                           labels = c("No Rain","Rain","Extreme Rain")),
    prop = Probability / 100,
    label_x = pmin(prop + 0.025, 1.25),  # mais espaço para texto
    label_txt = paste0(sprintf("%.2f", Probability), "%")
  )

# ---- Gráfico combinado ----
g_all <- ggplot(df_all_long, aes(x = prop, y = Level, fill = Level)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.5, color = "black", alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_text(aes(x = label_x, label = label_txt),
            hjust = 0, size = 4.2, fontface = "bold", color = "black") +
  facet_grid(Precipitation ~ Variable, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1),
                     limits = c(0, 1.25),  # 🔹 amplia o eixo para não cortar
                     expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05))) +  # 🔹 garante respiro
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("lightblue2","skyblue3","steelblue")) +
  labs(x = "Conditional Probability", y = "Level") +
  theme_light(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    plot.background  = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "beige", color = NA),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11, color = "black"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 9),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 9),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 10),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 10),
    legend.position = "none",
    panel.border = element_rect(color = "grey60", fill = NA),
    plot.margin = margin(10, 40, 10, 10)  # 🔹 margem direita maior
  )

# ---- Salvar imagem ----
dir.create("C:/Users/Pichau/INMET/probabilidades_condicionais", showWarnings = FALSE)

ggsave(
  filename = "C:/Users/Pichau/INMET/probabilidades_condicionais/cond_prob_combinado_atualizado.png",
  plot = g_all,
  width = 9.5,
  height = 7,
  dpi = 400,
  bg = "white"
)




```
